Born Hadassah ('myrtle'), she was an orphan raised by her cousin Mordecai of the tribe of Benjamin. All 55 occurrences are confined to the Book of Esther, where she courageously risks her life to save the Jewish people from Haman's decree. The arc from her selection as queen (Esth 2:17) through 'if I perish, I perish' (Esth 4:16) to her triumph makes her one of the Hebrew Bible's most celebrated heroines."
